reply_text:
Gideon closed ticket #8841 with support on 1 Jul. The fix was IT clearing a browser cache issue on the kiosk tablets, after which the standard template worked for their billing team. I replied in the thread on your message in #strategic-pod, citing Gideon's 09:17 post.

One conflict: a GBrain digest dated 30 Sep describes #8841 differently, as a Dock Door 14 kiosk check-in problem escalated to platform engineering. The channel post is the direct record of the 1 Jul closure, so I went with it, but the ticket itself should be checked before you rely on it.
